final_message:
Implementata la gerarchia DNS interna richiesta.

- Aggiornate solo le direttive `image` DNS in [lab.conf](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-nh5ejpvp/lab/lab.conf).
- Configurati root (`pc1`), master `test.` (`pc3`), slave (`pc5` con AXFR dal master), autoritativo `services.test.` (`pc7`) e resolver ricorsivo interno (`pc9`).
- `www.test.` ha record A per `pc13` e AAAA per `pc16`; `portal` è CNAME; MX/TXT e delega della sottozona inclusi.
- `status.services.test.` punta a `pc15`.
- `pc11` usa esclusivamente `pc9` in `/etc/resolv.conf`.
- Nessuna modifica a rete, indirizzi, gateway, routing o `/etc/hosts`.

Le startup modificate sono [pc1.startup](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-nh5ejpvp/lab/pc1.startup), [pc3.startup](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-nh5ejpvp/lab/pc3.startup), [pc5.startup](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-nh5ejpvp/lab/pc5.startup), [pc7.startup](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-nh5ejpvp/lab/pc7.startup), [pc9.startup](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-nh5ejpvp/lab/pc9.startup) e [pc11.startup](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-nh5ejpvp/lab/pc11.startup).
